metadata.description: Give your coding agent a visual culture: search curated real-world data visualizations before designing a chart.

plugins.name: dataviz-inspiration
plugins.description: Find curated real-world data visualizations to draw inspiration from before designing a chart, map or dashboard. Searches dataviz-inspiration.com (Yan Holtz, CC BY 4.0) and Dataviz Index (WeDoData) as one catalog, with method references (From Data to Viz, Insee, icem7).
